get.summary: Report that the API process is serving requests.
Return the signed-in user.
List the caller's own diaries, newest date first, one page per `before` date.

post.summary: Open the caller's diary for today in the given time zone, or for a past date, creating it if missing.

get.summary: Open one of the caller's diaries: its current text, generation and seq.
Look up the caller's committed batch by batch ID or by one operation ID.
List history points of a diary, newest first, one page per opaque cursor.
Read one committed version as server-rendered, read-only author runs.
The caller's own read coverage of a diary they may read, merged across devices.

post.summary: Add characters the caller saw on screen to their own read coverage; no one else ever learns of it.

get.summary: Open the partner's diary shared with the caller as one epoch: live, or frozen at the version sharing stopped.
Who wrote one visible character and when, in the text the caller may read.
The partner's diaries shared with the caller in a space, live or frozen, newest date first.
List the dates with the caller's own or the partner's shared diary, newest first, with list unread marks.
One date's own and shared diaries, as on the day list, with the caller's own Google copy of it.
The caller's current binding and their latest open invitation.
Spaces the caller takes part in, current or archived.
One space the caller takes part in, with its binding periods. No sharing range.

post.summary: Open a seven-day invitation link, closing the caller's previous one; a repeated requestId returns it without its token.
Revoke one of the caller's invitations; revoking it again changes nothing.
Show who invited the caller and whether it starts or restores a space; binds nothing.
Bind the caller to the inviter, storing each confirmed sharing range and opening that person's covered diaries to the other.
End the given binding period for both participants; the space and its history stay.

get.summary: The caller's own sharing range in a space; never the partner's.

put.summary: Confirm the caller's sharing range for the open period, opening covered diaries to the partner and freezing ones no longer covered.

get.summary: The caller's time zone and sleep schedule, and the partner's while the two are bound.

put.summary: Record the IANA time zone the caller's browser reports.
Set or clear the caller's usual sleep schedule.

get.summary: How many records of each space feature hold something the caller has not seen, for the entry dots.

post.summary: Records the caller has had on screen for about a second, each at the mark it came with.

get.summary: Both wish lists, the caller's own gifts in preparation, the gift wall and deletion notes.

post.summary: Add a wish of the caller.

put.summary: Change one of the caller's wishes, from the revision it was loaded at.

post.summary: Delete one of the caller's wishes.
"收到了" on one of the caller's wishes: it moves to the gift wall as a gift from the partner.
Start preparing a gift, for a wish of the partner or as a surprise; only the caller sees it until it is revealed.

put.summary: Change the name or link of a gift the caller created.

post.summary: Delete a gift the caller created; for one in preparation, stop preparing it.
Reveal a gift the caller is preparing: it and its card reach the partner and the gift wall.

put.summary: Write or change the giver's card of a gift.
Change a revealed gift's date on the gift wall; either of the two may.
Set or clear a revealed gift's occasion, a generic one or an anniversary; either of the two may.

get.summary: Every anniversary of the space with its next day, counted in the partner's local date except the caller's own birthday, and the one for the home strip.

post.summary: Add an anniversary of the space; at most one together day per space.

get.summary: One anniversary with its date in every year so far and the gifts given for it.

put.summary: Change the kind, whose birthday, name or note of an anniversary the caller added, from the revision it was loaded at.

post.summary: Delete an anniversary the caller added; gifts given for it keep its name.

put.summary: Correct an anniversary's date; either of the two may.
Turn the day count of an anniversary with a year on or off; either of the two may.
Set how many days ahead the caller is reminded of an anniversary; only the caller's own setting, allowed while unbound.

get.summary: The caller's own Google Drive connection and backup problems.

post.summary: Start connecting Google Drive (drive.file only): returns the consent URL.
Finish connecting Google Drive with the code and state the consent page returned.
Disconnect Google Drive: the grant is revoked at Google; Drive files stay.
Back up every waiting day now, without waiting for its history point ("现在备份").
